title: agentnative scorecard
description: JSON Schema for `anc audit --output json` scorecards (schema version 0.7). Schema 0.7 introduces the 7-status taxonomy (`opt_out` and `n_a` added to `status`, with matching counters in `summary`), per-row emission (one result per requirement-row instead of per audit_id; `tier` and `audit_id` fields added to each result), and antecedent propagation for conditional requirements. See docs/plans/2026-05-21-001-feat-scorecard-fairness-taxonomy-plan.md in the agentnative-site repo for the full taxonomy rationale.

schema_version.description: Scorecard schema version. Pre-launch additive — consumers feature-detect new fields rather than pin to an exact value.

results.description: Per-requirement-row outcomes (schema 0.7+). One entry per requirement row covered by an audit that ran in this invocation; a single probe whose `Audit::covers()` lists multiple rows produces multiple entries (each entry's `audit_id` carries the probe's id for provenance).

audience.description: Derived audience classification. `null` when the classifier could not produce a label (e.g., signal audit suppressed by `--audit-profile`, source-only run). Read-only over results; never gates totals or exit codes.

audience_reason.description: Reason the classifier declined a label, when `audience` is null. Omitted from JSON when `audience` has a value.

audit_profile.description: The `--audit-profile` value applied to this run, or null when no profile was set. Drives suppression of audits listed in the registry's SUPPRESSION_TABLE for that category.

spec_version.description: agentnative-spec version this `anc` build was compiled against. Sourced at build time from `src/principles/spec/VERSION`. Reads `unknown` when the vendored VERSION file was missing at build time.

id.description: Requirement-row identifier (schema 0.7+; matches `coverage/matrix.json` row ids, e.g. `p1-must-no-interactive`). The site's `/score/<tool>` page and external leaderboards pin on these strings. Previously (≤0.5) this carried the probe id.

label.description: Human-readable summary of what the audit verifies.

group.description: Principle bucket the audit belongs to. Cross-cutting groups (`CodeQuality`, `ProjectStructure`) appear regardless of `--principle` filter.

layer.description: Where the audit ran. Serialized as snake_case.

status.description: Outcome of the audit under the 7-status taxonomy (schema 0.7+). `opt_out` = deliberate non-adoption; `n_a` = conditional antecedent unmet (set by antecedent propagation); `skip` = linter probe limitation. Skips, errors, opt_outs, and n_as are all excluded from the transitional badge denominator.

evidence.description: Structured evidence for non-Pass statuses: the suppression-table marker, the unrecognized-flag list, the missing-file path, the antecedent propagation reason. `null` for clean Pass.

confidence.description: How directly the audit verifies its requirement. `high` for direct probes; `medium` for heuristics. Older consumers feature-detect.

tier.description: Requirement-row RFC 2119 level (schema 0.7+). `null` only when the row id is not in the registry — an internal inconsistency that should be loud.

audit_id.description: Probe that produced this row (schema 0.7+). One probe may produce multiple rows when its `Audit::covers()` slice names multiple requirements (e.g. `p3-version` covers both `p3-must-version` and `p3-should-version-short`).

Summary.description: Run-level outcome counts. Schema 0.7+ adds `opt_out` and `n_a` counters alongside the historic five.

LevelCounts.description: Per-level verification counts. `verified` counts requirements that had at least one audit declare `covers()` against them in this run, regardless of pass/fail.

CoverageSummary.description: Three-way coverage rollup over registry requirements: how many `must` / `should` / `may` requirements were verified by this run's audits.

ToolInfo.description: Identity of the scored target. `binary` is `null` for project-mode runs without a built artifact; `version` is `null` when probing failed, produced no parseable output, or was declined by the self-spawn guard.

AncInfo.description: Identity of the `anc` build that produced this scorecard.

PlatformInfo.description: OS / architecture pair sourced from `std::env::consts::{OS, ARCH}`.

RunInfo.description: Run-level facts. `invocation` is argv joined with spaces, captured before `inject_default_subcommand` rewrites bare paths. `started_at` is RFC 3339 UTC. `duration_ms` is wall-clock.

TargetInfo.description: What `anc audit` was pointed at. `path` is the basename (never an absolute path — protects against home-dir PII leaks). Always-present-null keys keep consumer code simple.

BadgeInfo.description: Agent-native badge metadata derived from this run. `score_pct` is `pass / (pass + warn + fail)` rounded to an integer percent — Skips and Errors are excluded from both sides of the ratio. `eligible` is `true` iff `score_pct >= 80` and a tool slug was derivable. `embed_markdown` is populated only when `eligible` (do-not-nag contract); `scorecard_url` / `badge_url` are populated whenever a slug exists so below-floor regressions shift color rather than 404.
